city-desc.chicago	<i>“风城”</i>经常成为美国禁酒令的冲突中心。这座城市坐落在密歇根湖湖畔，位于美国铁路网的十字路口上，到处都是富有的实业家和贫穷的移民劳动力，因其公然蔑视枯燥的法律和通过非法酒类销售获利而闻名。许多臭名昭著的犯罪组织在街道上发生冲突，其中就包括阿尔·卡彭的帮派和迪恩·奥巴尼恩的“北部帮”。\n\n在芝加哥，酒水交易可以畅通无阻，但起始地点并不都是对等的。市中心几乎可以从任何地方到达，但交易最集中的工业区和火车站却位于贫民区和西环，可能需要一些“活泛”的关系才能进入。桥梁是连接三个主要区域的关键枢纽，但也为竞争对手提供了封锁重要路线的机会。	"<i>The Windy City</i> was often at the center of conflict over Prohibition in the United States. Located on Lake Michigan at the crossroads of the nation's railways, and overflowing with wealthy industrialists and poor immigrant workforce, the city was infamous for its blatant defiance of dry laws and profiting off of illegal alcohol sales. Many famous criminal organizations clashed on its streets including Al Capone's Outfit and Dean O'Banion's North Side Gang.\n\nIn Chicago booze flows freely, but starting locations are not all made equal. Downtown is reasonably accessible from almost anywhere, however the highest concentration of industrial areas and train stations will be located around the Back of the Yards and West Loop which may require some creative relationship management to gain access to. Bridges are a key feature and link the three main regions, but provide opportunities for rivals to block off important routes."
city-desc.detroit	<i>“汽车城”</i>长期以来以其蓬勃发展的汽车工业而闻名。亨利·福特希望工厂里的工人们能够保持清醒，所以他旗帜鲜明地支持1918年颁布的达蒙法案，也就是第十八修正案的前身。但是，由于在整个禁令颁布期间，酒类销售在加拿大仍属合法，因此邻近的安大略省温莎市便成为了酒水走私的热门地区。“紫帮”是由一群走私贩子和抢劫犯组成的犯罪团伙，这可能是底特律最臭名昭著的团伙，他们甚至向阿尔·卡彭的芝加哥帮供应加拿大威士忌。\n\n底特律河将这座城市与邻近的加拿大安大略省温莎市分隔开。没有桥梁意味着两个城市之间没有常规通道，但是这条河确实为通过船只走私提供了空间。如果你与居住在底特律的加拿大人建立关系并提升信任程度，你就有机会资助跨境代理人和安全屋。然后，你就可以将资金和资源转移到这个新的安全屋，并利用你的加拿大船员采购<i>加拿大威士忌，</i>这是一种独特的酒水资源，可以在底特律出售，从而获得可观的利润。	"<i>The Motor City</i> has long been renowned for its booming automobile industry. Desiring a sober workforce, Henry Ford famously backed the Damon act of 1918, which was a precursor to the eighteenth amendment. But as the sale of alcohol remained legal in Canada throughout prohibition, neighboring Windsor, Ontario became a hotspot for alcohol smuggling. The Purple Gang, a criminal mob of bootleggers and hijackers, were perhaps Detroit's most notorious gang, going as far as supplying Canadian whiskey to Al Capone's Chicago Outfit.\n\nThe Detroit river separates the city from its Canadian neighbor of Windsor, Ontario. A lack of bridges means that there is no conventional access between the two cities, however the river does provide scope for smuggling across the border via boat. If you work your relationships and build some trust with Canadians living in Detroit you will have the opportunity to fund an agent and safehouse over the border. You can then transfer money and resources to this new safehouse and utilize your Canadian crew member to procure <i>Canadian whiskey,</i> a unique alcohol resource that can be sold back in Detroit for a tidy profit. "
city-desc.pittsburgh	在禁酒令颁布之初，<i>“钢铁城”</i>既是工业重镇，又是欧洲移民的大熔炉。也许是因为酒精对许多移民工人而言有着重要的文化意义，匹兹堡很快被禁酒领袖宣布为“美国最潮湿的地方”。来自西西里和那不勒斯的黑帮家族在城市北部和南部的领地上进行了激烈的争斗。\n\n匹兹堡出产两种独特的酒精饮品：<i>烈性苹果酒</i>和<i>拉基亚酒</i>。有了这两种酒，这个城市的酒水市场规模要比其他城市大得多，也更为多样化——这意味着你可以更快获得不错的开局并赚更多的金钱。然而，三条河流和丰富的山丘地形导致这里非常容易堵塞，这可能会在扩大领地时带来挑战，因此需要格外小心设置门面的位置并注意处理人际关系的方式。	"At the start of prohibition, the <i>Steel City</i> was both an industrial powerhouse and a melting pot of European nationals. Partly as a result of the cultural significance of alcohol for many of its migrant workers, Pittsburgh was soon declared the 'wettest spot in the United States' by prohibition leaders. Sicilian and Neapolitan crime families fought bitterly over territory in the north and south of the city.\n\nPittsburgh is home to two unique drinks: <i>applejack</i> and <i>rakija</i>. With these two additional alcohol types, this city has a much larger and more diverse market for alcohol than the other cities, meaning that it will be easier to get a faster start and earn more money overall. However, the three rivers and abundant hills create a ton of choke points which could present you with challenges when expanding your territory, so you'll need to be extra careful with where you set up your fronts and how you work your relationships."
city-desc.cincinnati	在禁酒令颁布之前，<i>“皇后城”</i>拥有当地人引以为豪的啤酒酿造和玉米威士忌蒸馏传统技术，邻近的肯塔基州则大量供应世界闻名的波本威士忌。乔治·莱姆斯原本是一名律师兼药剂师，后来摇身一变成了私酒贩子。他围绕沃尔斯泰德法案中的漏洞建立了自己的犯罪帝国，该漏洞使他能够重新利用酿酒厂生产酒精化合物。然后，他就能够通过广泛的药店网络将这种酒精用于“医疗目的”进行出售。\n\n在辛辛那提，你可以使用玉米作为私酒和本地驰名的<i>玉米威士忌</i>的新原料。但是，一旦你设法搞到了<i>肯塔基波本威士忌</i>，您就能够将其出售给要求苛刻的私酒贩子、非法酒吧和俱乐部来获得更高的价格。	"Before prohibition, the <i>Queen City</i> had a proud heritage of beer brewing and corn whiskey distilling, with neighboring Kentucky providing an ample supply of the world famous bourbon. The lawyer and pharmacist turned bootlegger, George Remus built his criminal empire around a loophole in the Volstead act which allowed him to repurpose distilleries to produce bonded alcohol. He was then able to sell this alcohol for 'medicinal purposes' through an extensive network of pharmacies.\n\nIn Cincinnati you'll have access to corn as a new ingredient for moonshine and the city's famed <i>corn whiskey.</i> But once you manage to get access to <i>Kentucky bourbon,</i> you will be able to command much higher prices, by selling it to highly demanding bootlegger, speakeasies, and clubs."

city-desc.philadelphia	1682年，在特拉华和舒尔基尔河的交汇处，威廉·潘的<i>兄弟之爱之城</i>作为宽容和自由的灯塔得以建成。这座美国独立的摇篮随后将这种宽容进一步发扬光大，最终招致了禁酒令的发布。在1921年《沃尔斯特德法案》生效之前，费城的街道和社区中大约有1700家酒吧。据估计，截止1930年，仍有大约1200家或多或少地在公开营业。\n\n费城著名的私酒贩，如麦克斯·霍夫和米奇·达菲，是东海岸私酒贸易的关键人物，他们从新泽西海岸以及城市的农村腹地通过公路和铁路网络带来了大量非法酒精。他们从特拉华河谷肆意扩张的化工企业所生产的工业酒精中获得了惊人的财富。麦克斯·霍夫一夜暴富，以至于他不得不创立了许多金融机构，比如臭名昭著的富兰克林抵押贷款与投资公司，来作为幌子为美国最有利可图的私酒生意洗钱。\n\n所有这些都让费城的街道充满了各种各样的生财计划，只要你的团伙有队长就可以执行这些计划。利用你的自酿白兰地，建立一个新的犯罪帝国吧。\n\n<b>这里的机会很大，所以你需要一些帮助。费城的帮派都是从引入第二名团伙成员发展起来的——即一名经验丰富的队长，由他来帮助你征服这座宾夕法尼亚州最大的城市。</b>	"At the confluence of the Delaware and Schuylkill Rivers, William Penn's <i>City of Brotherly Love</i> was founded in 1682 as a beacon for tolerance and freedom. This cradle of American independence extended this tolerance into Prohibition. Before the Volstead act came into effect in 1921, there were an estimated 1,700 saloons laced through Philadelphia's street and neighborhoods. By 1930, estimates were that roughly 1,200 still existed more or less in the open.\n\nPhilly's famous bootleggers like Max “Boo Boo” Hoff and Mickey Duffy were key players in the East Coast booze trade, brining illegal alcohol up from the New Jersey coast and along road and rail networks from the city's rural hinterlands. And they became staggeringly rich from the industrial alcohol produced in the Delaware Valley's sprawling chemical industry. So wealthy did Max Hoff become that he founded numerous financial institutions such as the infamous Franklin Mortgage & Investment Company, a money laundering front for what became the most lucrative bootlegging operation in the USA.\n\nAll of this fills the streets of Philadelphia with huge variety of schemes to pursue once your outfit has the captains to do it. Use the homemade brandy that you can manufacture and build up a new criminal empire.\n\n<b>So large are the opportunities here, you'll need some help. Outfits in Philadelphia start with a second crew member - a seasoned captain to help you take over Pennsylvania's largest city.</b>"
